title: bug: RSS widget poster images don't load for reddit feeds
body:
### Describe the bug

I added the reddit feed (https://www.reddit.com/r/selfhosted/.rss) to the RSS widget with "Show poster image" on, and the thumbnails never render. The poster boxes show up with the alt text but the image stays empty, and the requests fail with a 403 from reddit's CDN.   
   
I found the cause in `packages/request-handler/src/rss-feeds.ts`. The parser only checks enclosure and `media:content` for images, but reddit feed uses `media:thumbnail`. Because of that it always ends up in the regex fallback in `getImageFromStringAsFallback`, which matches up to the file extension and drops the query string. That's a problem because reddit puts the s= signature in the query string and their CDN rejects the request without it, hence the 403. 
     
The extracted enclosure comes out as `https://preview.redd.it/iggp10gibfhh1.jpeg`, but the URL in the feed is `https://preview.redd.it/iggp10gibfhh1.jpeg?width=640&crop=smart&auto=webp&s=0ea9429fb5bf159b2368f906c7b7edb3246140e3`. I tested both with curl and the truncated URL returns 403 while the full one returns 200.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add an RSS widget with https://www.reddit.com/r/selfhosted/.rss
2. Enable "Show poster image"
3. Wait for it to fetch. The poster boxes render with alt text but no image ever loads

### Impact

Not a blocker, the rest of the widget works fine, but the poster option is useless for reddit feeds. Any feed that uses `media:thumbnail` instead of enclosure or `media:content` should be affected the same way.

### Additional information

I added `media:thumbnail` to the `mediaProperties` array locally and it extracts the full signed URL, so images load. Happy to open a PR with that fix if it makes sense.

### Version

1.73.0

### Installation method

Docker Compose

### Browser

Firefox
